notes: ONE RECEIPT, SEVERAL ACCOUNTS. A payer often hands over one sum covering several things — a student paying admission, hostel and examination fees in a single deposit, or a remittance spanning several purposes. Fund Receipts now has a Split across several accounts button: each line credits its own account and may carry its own unit and project, the Amount field becomes the sum, and the ledger takes one bank debit against one credit per allocation. Crucially, the lodgement register carries ONE deposit — not the three separate receipts you used to have to book against one bank credit, which the reconciliation could never match. The printed OFFICIAL RECEIPT itemises what the one sum covered. A split receipt cannot also split out VAT or the tourism levy — a multi-line taxable sale is an Invoice, which carries per-line tax. CORRECTING A RECEIPT IS NOW AN EXACT COPY. Correcting a posted receipt used to rebuild its entries from the summary, which knew only one account. It now copies the posted lines verbatim onto the correction draft — every allocation, unit and narration exactly as posted — before you amend it. NO DATA RESHAPE: this installs straight over the previous version; a new optional column records the split as you typed it. Please still take a backup first — Backup & Export, Back up now.
